description: Broadcast a base64 transaction that Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, or a Ledger already signed, and wait for confirmation. This is how the owner side works without any secret key on this machine: any tool that returns "prepared_for_wallet" hands you a transaction_base64 to sign and pass here. Blockhashes expire in about 60 seconds, so if this reports an expired blockhash, re-run the tool that prepared it.

signed_transaction.description: The signed transaction, base64-encoded, as your wallet returned it.

name: send_signed_transaction
title: Broadcast a transaction your wallet signed
